title: Writable service component with SYSTEM impersonation primitive
impact: A writable service component plus a token-impersonation primitive is a strong local path to SYSTEM.
remediation: Remove non-admin write on the service path/keys; remove SeImpersonate from the service account where possible.
description: A writable service component co-occurs with an impersonation primitive; chain likely yields SYSTEM.

title: Writable PATH/app directory with a privileged consumer
impact: A writable directory searched by a privileged process may allow DLL/binary hijack.
remediation: Remove write for non-admins on directories searched by privileged processes.
description: A writable search-path directory co-occurs with a privileged consumer; review for DLL hijack.

title: Backup/Restore privilege on a domain-reachable host -> NTDS/hive dump
impact: SeBackupPrivilege lets a non-admin read any file (SAM/SYSTEM, or NTDS.dit on a DC) -> offline secret extraction -> domain credentials.
remediation: Remove SeBackup/SeRestore from non-tier-0 principals; monitor volume-shadow and raw-hive reads.
description: A backup/restore privilege co-occurs with domain-sensitive context. Chain: read SAM/SYSTEM (or NTDS.dit on a DC) via the privilege -> secretsdump offline -> credentials.
